change.summary: Make password reset tokens single-use and expire after 15 minutes

obligations.behavior: A valid unused token within the expiry window resets the password exactly once
obligations.expected: Password changes and the token becomes consumed
obligations.testName: valid token resets password and is consumed
obligations.evidenceNote: Exercises persistence and token consumption in the integration boundary

obligations.behavior: A consumed token cannot be used again
obligations.expected: Second reset attempt is rejected and password remains unchanged

obligations.behavior: A token older than 15 minutes is rejected
obligations.expected: Expired token is rejected without changing password

broaderChecks.note: Replace placeholders with real commands before strict verification
